integrity: The analytic derivation and its stated constants were reconstructed and checked against an independent triangle formula and the published square formula. Same-model scientific review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Planar convex polygons; fixed 1<p<2 for the cusp. General smooth bodies and higher-dimensional polytopes are not treated. Finite checks do not establish the quantified theorem. Possible unindexed prior equivalent remains a priority risk.
title: Universal facet cusps and sharp convexity loss for planar Fourier mean bodies
